attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24). Assigned static addressing on node2/node3 eth1 and node1 eth1/eth2, added cross-LAN static routes on node2/node3, and applied a VyOS forward-filter firewall on node1: default-action drop, rule 5 accepts established/related, rule 10 accepts only TCP/5432 from lan-a to lan-b. Verified TCP/5432 succeeds while all other traffic (TCP/22, ICMP) between the LANs is dropped, both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time with boot-identity proof of each restart and post-restart functional re-verification.
